citation: Thresholds after ICAR soil-test rating conventions and State Agricultural University package-of-practices; lime/gypsum/FYM rates are indicative and must be confirmed by a local soil test.

strongly_acidic.finding: Strongly acidic soil (pH {value}); phosphorus and micronutrient availability is restricted and Al/Mn toxicity is possible.
strongly_acidic.action: Apply agricultural lime 2-3 t/ha 4-6 weeks before sowing; re-test after one season.

acidic.finding: Slightly acidic soil (pH {value}); acceptable for most crops.
acidic.action: No liming needed. For acid-sensitive crops apply lime 0.5-1 t/ha.

alkaline.finding: Mildly alkaline soil (pH {value}); Fe/Zn availability may drop.
alkaline.action: Use acidifying fertilisers (ammonium sulphate), add organic matter, foliar-spray Zn/Fe if deficiency shows.

strongly_alkaline.finding: Strongly alkaline soil (pH {value}); likely sodicity and poor structure.
strongly_alkaline.action: Apply gypsum 2-5 t/ha based on a gypsum-requirement test, leach with good-quality water, incorporate FYM/green manure.

low.finding: Low organic carbon ({value}%); poor structure, low water- and nutrient-holding capacity.
low.action: Apply FYM/compost 5-10 t/ha, include a legume in rotation, retain crop residue, avoid excess tillage.

medium.action: Maintain with 2.5-5 t/ha FYM every season and residue return.

low.finding: Low CEC ({value} cmol(c)/kg); the soil holds little exchangeable nutrient and leaches easily.
low.action: Split N and K into 3+ doses, band fertiliser near roots, mulch, build organic matter.

high.action: Single or two-split application is fine.

low.action: Full recommended N dose in 3 splits; add 5 t/ha FYM and a legume in rotation.

medium.action: Apply the crop's recommended N in 2-3 splits.

high.action: Reduce N by ~25% of the recommended dose; watch for lodging.

low.action: Apply full recommended P2O5 as basal (DAP/SSP); in acidic soil use rock phosphate + FYM.

medium.action: Apply ~75% of recommended P2O5 as basal.

high.action: Apply ~50% of recommended P2O5 or skip for one season; monitor.

low.action: Apply full recommended K2O (MOP), half basal and half at active growth.

medium.action: Apply ~75% of recommended K2O in 2 splits.

texture_notes.sand: Very low water/nutrient retention; irrigate little and often, split N heavily, mulch, prioritise organic matter.
texture_notes.loamy sand: Low retention; frequent light irrigation, 3+ N splits, add compost.
texture_notes.sandy loam: Workable but drains fast; 2-3 nutrient splits, maintain organic matter.
texture_notes.loam: Well balanced; standard irrigation and fertiliser scheduling.
texture_notes.silt loam: Good water holding but can crust; avoid working when wet, keep residue cover.
texture_notes.silt: Prone to crusting and compaction; minimise traffic, add organic matter.
texture_notes.sandy clay loam: Moderate retention with some drainage risk when wet; 2 nutrient splits.
texture_notes.clay loam: High retention, slow drainage; irrigate less often and deeper, avoid tillage when wet.
texture_notes.silty clay loam: High retention, poor aeration risk; ensure drainage, avoid compaction.
texture_notes.sandy clay: Hard when dry, sticky when wet; deep tillage, gypsum if sodic, organic matter.
texture_notes.silty clay: Very slow drainage; raised beds/drainage, careful irrigation scheduling.
texture_notes.clay: Very high retention, very slow drainage, cracks on drying; deep infrequent irrigation, drainage, gypsum if sodic, never work when wet.
